# AI

Fields and actions filled by a model, the assistant beside the admin, and MCP.

- [AI fields](../reference/ai.md#ai-fields): A model fills a field from a prompt that uses the record's other fields, after each change.
- [AI actions](../reference/ai.md#ai-actions): A button asks a model to write a field now, such as a suggested priority or a translation.
- [Assistant](../reference/assistant.md): A chat beside the admin that answers questions about the app, reads its data and proposes changes for approval.
- [Choice of model](../reference/assistant.md#which-backend): The assistant runs on OpenRouter or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, also a local one.
- [Assistant tools](../reference/assistant.md#the-apps-own-tools): Your own tools for the assistant, acting on records as the user.
- [MCP server](../reference/mcp.md#the-tools): AI clients connect to the app over MCP as the signed-in person: they list the resources in a small first call, describe one resource's fields when they need them, and find and read records within that person's access, soft-deleted ones too when asked.
- [MCP counts](../reference/mcp.md#the-tools): AI clients count the records a filter finds, in all or per value of a field such as a status, without reading the records.
- [MCP result size](../reference/mcp.md#result-size): Every tool result fits what AI clients take, as valid JSON: long values are cut and named, a page holds fewer records, and the client reads the rest in pieces.
- [MCP app icon](../reference/mcp.md#the-apps-icon): AI clients show the app's own icon beside its name when someone adds its MCP endpoint.
- [MCP writes](../reference/mcp.md#writes): When turned on, for every resource or only those you list, AI clients create, update and delete records after the person approves each write.
- [Small MCP write results](../reference/mcp.md#what-a-write-returns): A write over MCP returns the record's key, new ETag, the fields written and the read-only fields that changed, not the whole record; `fields` asks for more.
- [MCP writes without approval](../reference/mcp.md#writes-without-approval): Roles you name, such as service accounts, write over MCP without being asked to approve each write; everyone else is still asked.
- [MCP comments](../reference/mcp.md#comments): AI clients read a record's comments, and with MCP writes on add one after the person approves it.
- [MCP batch writes](../reference/mcp.md#batch-writes): When MCP writes are on, AI clients make many creates, updates and deletes across resources in one transaction, after the person approves the batch.
- [Connected apps](../reference/auth.md#oauth-for-mcp-clients): People allow an AI client to sign in, and disconnect it later.
- [MCP address](../reference/mcp.md#connecting-a-client): Signed-in people find the app's MCP address on their account page, copy it or add it to Claude in one click.
